definition: A hacktivist collective that creates and releases purpose-built benevolent E.L.F.s into GLMZ's infrastructure — digital fairy godmothers designed to help the poor. Breadcrumb E.L.F.s deposit Quanta into empty wallets. Keyhole E.L.F.s unlock food dispensers. Blindspot E.L.F.s create surveillance gaps in refugee corridors.
origin: Self-named — their manifesto reads: 'The corps built a world where the poor need miracles. We build the miracles.'
example: Wishing Well dropped new elves in the Narrows last week. Three food dispensers unlocking after midnight. Axiom can't figure out how.
